title: tc-running-now
description:
A live status of agents' background tasks for a header or sidebar – a quiet pill with how many are running and how
many need you, opening a panel of the tasks grouped by Needs you, Running and Recently done.

tasks.description: The tasks, in any order – the panel groups them and keeps their order within a group

heading.description: The panel's title, and the start of the pill's description

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; leave it unset and the element keeps its own clock while the panel is open

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultRunningNowLabels

notifiable.description: Offer "notify me when it's done" on the tasks still going

notify.description: The tasks the person will be told about when they finish

notifyChannels.description: Ways to be told – "In app", "Email", "Push"; given, the bell opens a choice of them

notifyVia.description: The channels chosen for each watched task, with `notifyChannels`

title.description: What the task is, in a few words: "Check vendor records"

progress.description: 0–1 while it runs; left out, its ring turns

started.description: When it started, epoch ms – for the elapsed time

ended.description: When it finished, epoch ms – stops its clock
